name: GORGEOUS BEACH VIBES ON THE NORTH SHORE OF OAHU

description.text: A rustic and elegant wedding tucked-away on Oahu’s North Shore; an intimate beach front event adorned with natural greenery and ethereal white chiffon.
LOVE STORY

Mario and I met through mutual friends at a birthday party in 2009. We became friends quickly and bonded over a common love of travel, food, music and adventure. I was drawn to Mario for his happy, funny, up-beat and "life of the party" personality. One day we were out with friends I began to wonder what it would be like to kiss him. I made a bold move, and didn't find myself wondering any more. Right after we kissed, he asked me out on a date. I was a little nervous because if things didn't pan out, I knew it would affect the dynamics of our group of friends. But I thought he was worth the risk (I was right!). He took me to sushi on a Monday night and we sat for hours talking, laughing and really getting to know each other on a whole different level. The next day he texted, asking me out on that coming Saturday. I said yes and asked what he wanted to do. He told me it was a surprise, and to dress comfortably. He too me to Hollywood Forever cemetery, where they screen old movies on Rudy Valentino's Mausoleum. We sat under the stars eating all sorts of delicious treats he cooked earlier that day, while watching Paper Moon. That night, on our second date, I knew I had fallen for him.
FAVORITE ELEMENTS

I loved all of the little details that we incorporated into the day. Insteadof using guests full names, we used the nicknames that we call them, because wewanted the day to feel like an extension of who we were. Guests got anunexpected surprise when looking for their spots! We also wrote each guest apersonalized note. A friend of mine did calligraphy on the bottom of my weddingshoes. The ink used was my something blue. Mario wore cuff links that I gave tohim for his 30th birthday. All these little things really added up andmade the day a wonderful reflection of who we are as couple.
WEDDING ESSENTIALS

Other than for Mario to show up... ;) I'd say the flowers. I used to be a florist and flowers are my passion. So it was really important to me that there were some jaw dropping incredible flowers. For Mario, the food and wine was most important. A chef can't have mediocre food and drinks at his own wedding!

CHAMPAGNE POP

When Kathleen and Nathan were looking for venues, they knew they wanted to return to where they first met, The Modern Honolulu. Kathleen and Nathan wanted a luxurious feel to their wedding and made an effort to make sure that even the smaller details were elegantly executed. The couple accentuated their champagne theme from their champagne tower to their mini champagne bottles given as favors to their guests. Their gold and white color palette paired beautifully with light colored linen with gold chivari chairs and gold place settings. The added glass votive filled with floating tea lights gave the entire ballroom an intimate and romantic touch. So many customized factors, like the mirrored seating chart, made this wedding indistinguishably unique.

description.text: A chic ceremony and reception at the beautiful Lanikūhonua estate, covered in classic white and ivory, complete with crystal chandeliers, opulent floral arrangements and other elegant details.
LOVE STORY
We both knew we had found "The One" in a fairly early stage of our relationship. Alice and I (Kevin) dated for four years when I surprised Alice by proposing to her on her 30th birthday.
MEMORABLE MOMENTS

Kevin: For me, it was during my first sight of her as she was walking down the aisle. I was so emotional, that I couldn't hold back my tears but I expected that to happen. It was such a wonderful experience.
Alice: My most memorable moment was listening to Kevin say his vows to me. I felt the whole world freeze, and it was just two of us in that moment.
FAVORITE ELEMENTS

Kevin: Honestly, Mona and Rya were such a huge help that day. Everything was set up perfectly and in accordance with Alice's vision. I really loved the flowers everywhere, from the ceremony setup, great music and DJ, to the awesome food, and entertainment. I can't think of one single thing that I didn't love. It was an amazing day.

Alice: I loved everything at our wedding. All the decorations were set up exactly the way I imaged my dream wedding would be like. My favorite part was probably the decorations in the reception tent. Many of the guests told us that it was the most perfect wedding they had ever attended.
DESTINATION WEDDING

We can't think of a better location to have a wedding than in Hawaii where there's beautiful weather, amazing beaches, great food, and such a positive vibe on the island. Most of our guests who came to the wedding had a great romantic and relaxing time. It was unbelievable to share that special moment with all of them in Hawaii.

name: CLASSIC AND INTIMATE SOPHISTICATION AT THE MODERN HONOLULU

description.text: This wedding showcased a dreamy ceremony on the sand at The Modern Honolulu’s Private Sunset Beach, accentuated with soft white and cream details, followed by a chic and sophisticated reception in the Ballroom.
LOVE STORY

Let's just call it fate. You wouldn't believe that two people could end up together after I (Jasmine) gave Glen the wrong number accidentally and yet we still managed to end up together. I was travelling in Australia and had a new cell number that I couldn't quite remember and thought I gave Glen the right number after a random chance meeting.

After he "didn't" call me I figured it just wasn't meant to be. Little did I know, I'd run into him a few weeks later, where he would try to avoid me thinking that I was the girl who gave him the wrong number.

Luckily for us, Dave, a brave friend of Glen's was determined to get to the bottom of why a girl would give him the wrong number. Dave brought Glen and I were face to face which helped us to discover what had actually happened.
As cliché as it sounds, I guess you could say the rest is history.
MUST HAVES

As much as everyone says the day is about you, we wanted our guests to be at ease. We wanted to exude a feeling of relaxation and fun. This would not have been possible without Mona, She brings the calm to an industry that is known to be stressful, and because of her composed and organized manner, our guests were able to seamlessly move throughout the day without any confusion or interruption. This was a key component to helping us enjoy the day for ourselves.
FAVORITE ELEMENTS

The thing that stands out to us the most when we reflect back on our wedding is the fact that every detail and every element that came together truly felt like us. We stayed true to who we were and didn't compromise on what we wanted, despite what people tell you, despite what the traditions are or meant to be, we stuck to what we wanted and the day was a true reflection of who we are. However in saying that, Fong from Floral Inspirations absolutely blew us away. Her arrangements and attention to detail took our reception room from ordinary to spectacular. That's a woman who knows how to transform a room with flowers!

name: A PRIVATE CHAPEL WEDDING AT OCEAN CRYSTAL CHAPEL, AND A CELEBRATION AT PRINCE WAIKIKI

description.text: A stunning ceremony held at the Ocean Crystal Chapel, this pretty and pink celebration emphasized feminine shades of coral and peach, balanced out with soft shades of grey. The ceremony was followed by a reception at the Hawaii Prince Hotel.
LOVE STORY

High school sweethearts Victor and Kasandra have been together since senior year and finally decided to tie the knot after seven years of dating. When Victor decided to pop the question on a get away vacation to Disneyland, Kasandra naturally said "yes" and the happiest day of their lives began in the happiest place on earth.
MEMORABLE MOMENT
"Our most memorable moment was the 'First Look' when I (Kasandra) walked down the aisle. To see Victor tear up as he first saw me made me feel so loved."
FAVORITE ELEMENTS

"Our wedding colors were coral, blush, and gold. We wanted to stick to an elegant theme, so my bridesmaids were all in floor length dresses and groomsmen were in gray suits. We had a 3-tier cake that was provided by the Hawaii Prince Hotel."
WEDDING ESSENTIALS

"I really want to make sure that our wedding was about us and our love. As much as I wanted our guests to all have fun, I knew that ultimately, it came down to how much Victor and I enjoyed ourselves."

name: ELEGANT AND DELICATE AT THE MOANA SURFRIDER

description.text: A beautiful garden inspired wedding on the Diamond Lawn of the Moana Surfrider embellished with an abundance of hanging floral arrangements paired with simple delicate details.

Michelle and Spencer’s wedding was the perfect blend of rustic and vintage styles. Elements of a relaxed and carefree country-style décor were evident at the ceremony from the floral-filled mint mason jars hanging from twine along the aisle to the burlap-wrapped bouquets. Then heading into the reception, guests’ tables were dressed with vintage lace and classic gold details. This blend was especially prevalent in the florals of soft peach roses and white hydrangea mixed with dusty miller and leafy greens. But of course, the center of attention was the bride and groom. Michelle and Spencer’s sweetheart table displayed their marquee light initials on fluffy Le Fleur rosette linen placed before a uniquely draped backdrop donning large intricate paper flowers.

name: OCEAN VIEWS AND CLASSIC ELEGANCE AT LOULU PALM ESTATE

description.text: A dazzling seaside ceremony and reception with breathtaking ocean views, this event was finished with clean, chic design elements and an all-white color palette, accented with hints of Tiffany blue.
LET’S FLY AWAY

Connie and Jeff are a unique couple with an equally unique and beautiful love story. Their wedding fused together chic design with personal touches that really gave insight to who they are as a couple. To represent Connie, who is a pilot, the aisle was adorned with fresh petals in the shape of clouds and propellers. Small subtle propellers were also added to the couple’s monogram that was seen throughout the wedding.

The couple had a large list of bridal party members and special guests, so we created multiple aisles to not only accommodate but to add visual interest to the ceremony. The cozy cocktail area was complete with plush white sofas for the guest to lounge. The reception area of the estate was held under a gorgeous dining tent draped in white chiffon. Their all- white linen and floral arrangements were hinted with Tiffany-blue accents, seen in the menu cards and table place cards, aptly named after the couples favorite cities to visit.

name: SOPHISTICATED DETAILS AND ELEGANT DESIGN AT LANIKŪHONUA

description.text: From a custom wedding dress to elegant design at the beautiful Lanikūhonua, family and friends came together to celebrate love.
LOVE STORY

I first noticed Sovattey when I walked past her blackjack table at Caesar’s Palace in February of 2008. Struck by her amazing beauty, I decided to abandon my evening plans and try my luck at blackjack. It was a classic “boy likes girl” and “girl ignores boy” scenario. While I may not have won at blackjack, I did eventually win a strong friendship with Sovattey. The more time we spent getting to know each other, the more we realized we had a ton in common. Now we are inseparable.
V.I.P.

Our wedding wouldn’t have felt right without our closest friends and family to celebrate with us. Over 70 strong made the journey from the mainland. Most significant was Sovattey’s grandmother, who attended despite the physical challenges of traveling from Las Vegas. We thought she might not be medically cleared to fly, but fortunately she was able to make the trip. We’ll never forget her smiles when she was wheeled out to the dance floor, and her joyous expressions when she saw the ocean for the first time in decades. Nothing could have been more important to us than being able to share these unforgettable moments with our loved ones.
MUST HAVES

Since our wedding would be a once in a lifetime event, we decided to splurge on quite a few things. Most significant would be the wedding dress itself. It was custom designed by Galia Lahav in Israel with some unique design elements Sovattey requested. It may have taken four months to make, but when the big day arrived, it was absolutely worth it as Sovattey looked breath-taking in her stunning one-of-a-kind dress.
FAVORITE ELEMENT

It’s difficult to pick a single favorite element as everything about our wedding was amazing. We loved the intimate Lanikūhonua location, the elegant touches of chandeliers and drapes, the beautiful flowers, the delicious food, the shaved ice station, the photo booth, and all our guests rocking the dancefloor. What stood out the most though was the big screen video professionally produced by Isle Media. Not only did it show traditional photographs of our childhoods, but it also included drone footage from our Cambodian ceremony the day before as well as video clips from our wedding and reception, which took place literally minutes before. We all couldn't believe something of such high quality could be produced so quickly.

name: A MARIE-ANTOINETTE THEME AND LAVISH GOLD TOUCHES AT LANIKŪHONUA

description.text: A fun Marie-Antoinette-themed ceremony and reception decorated with sweet pink florals enhanced with lavish gold elements all draped in beautiful white canopies on the Lanikūhonua ocean-front estate.
LET THEM EAT CAKE!

Valentina and Albert's wedding was designed with a modern spin on eighteenth century Marie Antoinette, using soft pastels accented with gold paired. At the center of the reception, the wedding party sat at a table glistening with gold-sequin linen, while the newlyweds cozied up on a sweetheart sofette at the head of the table. Guests surrounded them seated at tables dressed with a soft floral bliss chiffon linen topped with opulent pink and ivory floral centerpieces. Rather than the traditional tiered wedding cake, Valentina and Albert also chose to incorporate a dessert table filled with several cakes and small sweets, to evoke an impression of a decadent tea party fit for royalty.
